segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ זָרַק לְתוֹךְ אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת וְנִתְגַּלְגֵּל חוּץ לְאַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת — פָּטוּר. חוּץ לְאַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת וְנִתְגַּלְגֵּל לְתוֹךְ אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת — חַיָּיב.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If «one threw» an object in the public domain, intending for it to land «within four cubits,» meaning that he had no intention of violating the Torah prohibition of carrying, «and» the object «rolled» and went «beyond four cubits, he is exempt.» However, if one threw an object with the intention of it landing «beyond four cubits, and» the object «rolled» back «within four cubits, he is liable» from when he originally threw the object.

moves.summary: Within four then rolled out: exempt; beyond four then rolled back: liable.

positions.claim: thrown within four and rolled beyond: exempt; thrown beyond four and rolled back within: liable
